senses.gloss: f. (denom. of כְּפָר) belonging to the village, wild.—כלב כ׳ village dog, ferocious dog.
units: Tosef. Kil. V, 8 כלב כ׳ וכ׳ a Kuf’ri dog is a species of wild beasts (not a domestic animal).

<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 1:6">Kil. I, 6</cite> <he>כלב הכ׳ והשועל וכ׳</he> the wild dog and the jackal … are heterogeneous (<cite ref="K00674"><he>כלאים</he></cite>). Y. ib. I, 27ᵃ bot. (not <he>כופרין</he>).
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:30">Lam. R. to I, 4</cite>; a. e.—<he>בצל כ׳</he> wild onion, opp. to <he>ב׳ בני המדינה</he> townsmen’s (garden) onion.

<cite ref="Nedarim 26b">Ned. 26ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Nedarim 66a:6">66ᵃ</cite> <he>הכ׳ יפה וכ׳</he> (Ar. <he>הכּוּפְרִים יפין</he>) the wild onion is good for the heart (stomach); Tosef. ib. V, 1 <he>הכופרין יפה</he> (corr. acc.), opp. <he>בני בצלים</he> (Var. <cite ref="U00048"><he>שאר</he></cite>) small onions.—Pl. <he>כּוּפְרִיִּים</he>, <cite ref="K00351"><he>כּוּפְרִים</he></cite>, <cite ref="K00351"><he>כּוּפְרִין</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 8:17">Tosef. B. Kam. VIII, 17</cite>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 2:3">Tosef. Ab. Zar. II, 3</cite>. Tosef. Ned. l. c.; Ned. l. c., v. supra; a. e.
